title: GCP Orphaned Public IP

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `google:gcp:audit` events matching `*` into `index=gcp`. Confirm UC-4.4.68 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `google:gcp:audit` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=gcp` sourcetype=`google:gcp:audit` collected via Splunk cloud TA for GCP; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

description: Monitors GCP resources for orphaned public ip. This UC monitors `google:gcp:audit` for gcp orphaned public ip and surfaces events for SOC triage, change review, and compliance evidence.
value: Unassociated public IPs may indicate incomplete cleanup or shadow IT. Detecting gcp orphaned public ip early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Splunk cloud TA for GCP with the modular input for `google:gcp:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `protoPayload.methodName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" eventName="AllocateAddress" OR eventName="DisassociateAddress"
| table _time protoPayload.methodName protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.68_gcp_orphaned_public_ip_68"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp orphaned public ip. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the GCP Logs Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `protoPayload.methodName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_68_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk cloud TA for GCP and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of gcp orphaned public ip so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
